data.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 05 Oct 2026 The European Commission has concluded that Poland's plan to support the extension of capacity of a factory of truck producer MAN Trucks Sp. z o. o. in Niepołomice in the Małopolskie region is not in line with EU State aid rules. Therefore, Poland cannot disburse the aid.

data.title: Kremlin: Meeting with winners of nationwide teacher competitions
data.summary: On Teachers’ Day, the President held, via videoconference, a meeting with the winners of nationwide teacher competitions, namely, Teacher of the Year, Director of the Year, First Teacher, Educator of the Year, Counsellor of the Year, I Give My Heart to Children, Best Teacher of Native Language and Literature, Special Education Teacher, and Educational Psychologist, as well as the finalists of the Klassnaya Tema! television show. In his opening remarks, the President congratulated education workers on their professional holiday.
